ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across the lateral lobes. High-contrast black pigmentation is localized along the trailing edge, terminal tips, and central peduncle region. Fine black stippling and mottling are concentrated near the median notch and inner lobe boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 2-5 pixels along the entire trailing boundary. Notable jagged peaks present on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex trailing edges tapering to acute, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixel nodes (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized calcified clusters at lobe extremities; small isolated dark circular pigmentation spot located in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe's white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'splatter' pattern of black mottling radiating from the median notch onto the white lobe surfaces.
